_help: Add the product's key pages and every API route a user hits, e.g. { "path": "/api/v1/health", "expect": [200, 429] } or { "path": "/api/v1/convert", "method": "POST", "body": { "from": "km", "to": "mi", "value": 5 }, "expect": [200, 429] }. API routes list 429 too: the load runs from one IP, so the per-IP rate limit answering 429 is the protection working. Never real customer data.
_note: Finealth: the licence route answers 400 for the dummy key (never a real key) and 429 once the strict 5/min limit is hit - both are correct. NFR-012.
